en: A vintage postcard featuring a landscaped public square with flower beds, walking paths, benches, and several historic buildings surrounding the area. The buildings feature typical European architectural styles of the late 19th or early 20th centuries. The sky has a gradient watercolor-like effect, common in colored postcards of that era. The top contains text in German, Russian, and Latvian.
